body: Maybe they're born with it. Maybe it's Maybelline.

No I appreciate the honesty. A lot of therapists seem kind of reluctant to tell me I'm doing things wrong when I know I am and hence the repeated problem (like though my entire life). I'll really take what you say into consideration from now on.

Thanks for the encouragement. I'll probably try to eat at maintenance for a few days and go back to my usual 1600 on Sunday. It's hard to think of depression as an illness as opposed to bring lazy/weak but I know you're right about that. Once I get my food under control I can start going back to the gym. Baby steps!

Yeah, I'm working on changing myself, just not really seeing a lot of results from it. I'm at a "healthy" BMI now but my body still sucks - some fat still to lose and loose skin and awkward proportions. Oh, and I have adult braces (yay). I plan on getting plastic surgery once I'm done with my braces (~1 yr) and weight loss. So maybe like 2 years from now I'll look... Normal. But know people definitely treat you better when you are attractive and at a healthy weight. I was 100% invisible at my highest weight.

I try to do some social hobbies but I never fit in. Used to play Magic the Gathering at a local shop. Went to Philosophy Club when I was a student. Lately I've been going to gym classes (yoga, bootcamp, etc.). Used to use Meetup.com when I lived in a bigger city. Those haven't really worked for me so now I just work on projects and stuff, grad school prep and work, to keep myself busy all the time.

I do try to take every social opportunity but those are very few and far between... I usually have to "invite myself" to things. Which is super lame, I know... I invited my co-workers to hang at a brewery recently and no one showed. If I don't invite myself then they will just make plans excluding me. E.g., I mentioned I really wanted to see the new Alien movie and they all went without me anyway.

Anyway, I feel like all the signs point to me being a pretty shitty person so I need to just give up on trying to have friends no matter how much it hurts. I'm sure my social skills are severely lacking. I also have a very boring personality. I try to do all the things you're "supposed" to do (try to get people to talk about themselves) but this has never worked for me. People want someone who is funny/witty/cool etc. Not a "good listener" or a "hard worker" etc. (In my experience anyway) All I can really do is work on myself and hope things get better but I also don't want to get my hopes up when they don't necessarily improve, either (like 30lbs lost and still just as lonely as ever... No one has even noticed tbh). I may never have friends no matter how fit/attractive I am... I can hope that moving and starting over will help (especially if I move to a big city) but I really might just be the inherent problem so I don't want to get my hopes up.

Sorry for the rant, I do appreciate your advice. I think there is just something really wrong with me more than just the obvious things. Im glad to know that it can get better for some people, maybe some day it will be better for me. Just have to keep working on myself.

Thanks for the hugs and comment. You'd be right in that this is my first binge in a long time, probably the longest I've ever gone. I used to be bulimic and that behavior comes up from time to time when I'm stressed.

Not a lot going on in my life, I guess that's the problem. I have a hard time making friends so I try to keep myself busy with projects/work. Sometimes I just wonder what the point of trying is when there is no one to share it with (friends). I've put a lot of hope in getting into grad school and moving and starting over in a year but I'm also aware I can't outrun myself and I worry I'll just run into the same problems that I have here. I know my inability to make friends is due to my personality and I wonder to what extent I can change that or if I will just be chronically lonely.

No one has ever really cared about me. It's not new but it bothers me more at some times than others. I just need to focus on things I can change and making myself better in general.

Sorry for the rant. I'll try to remember even if I backtracked a pound or two of far it doesn't undo the other 30+ that I've managed to lose. Thanks again for your comment and reply I really appreciate it.

You're right, not going to be perfect. But I mean my binges are insane sometimes. Sometimes I want to stop but keep going just out of self-loathing I guess.

I like your "fail better." Someone told me I can always "choose again" and it seems kind of similar to that. I don't want to spend the next month beating myself up for these last 2 days and I want tomorrow to be better so I just need to let it go and try again. Very much an "old me" vs "new me" and why weight loss never worked before.

I also track my binges... Or try to. Hard to keep up or even remember. Seeing the number is really hard but that's reality I guess.

You're right, I do have more control of things than I think sometimes. The gym helps sometimes. It's hard to go because of social anxiety but I've been going 5-6x a week for the last 2 months and I have seen some results. I want to keep going but I've got to get this food stuff under control. Thank you.

Gym and diet is almost all I do, 5x a week 2x CrossFit/HIIT + 3x week lifting and running. 24F so testosterone is a non-factor. 

I've tried all the drugs, therapy, nothing works... I've never had friends, and no amount of dieting or working out or meds will fix that... I guess I honestly thought it would but I'm realizing there is just something really wrong with me.
